items: Concurrent terminal cleanup and operator release serialize blind Git restoration through the capsule lock, preserving the candidate and allowing reset to finish
Read retained comparison patches, proof and findings with explicit missing-data and base-compatibility checks
Read an operator-configured benchmark dataset and original-usage receipts without exposing arbitrary filesystem paths

Worker session accounting counts tool calls from the same transcript as turns and tokens, for every runner, and splits calls, tokens and wall time at the run's checklist marks. The run record keeps the totals; each session receipt keeps the per-step table

Blind workers get a boundary `mktemp` that writes its default file in the trial directory. Bare `mktemp`, `prepare-sandbox`, `-t`, combined flags such as `-dt`, and `--directory` use that directory. The seatbelt denies `/var/folders`. An explicit template stays where the caller put it, and a template after `--` stays too
